about: Phase 25 pack v2 (flaw (c)) regression baseline, FAKE models (CI's routing.test.yaml) = the CODE path, after rule R1 (Phase 25e: a resource that rose within 60 min after a same-service cause is its mechanism). S22 still FAILS on purpose: a second, opposite flaw, left unfixed for a stated reason (ADR-037). CI fails when a case that passed here fails, or a case without a wrong HIGH claim gains one. A fix updates this file in the same PR. 6 synthetic scenarios written for this eval: an upper bound.

source.where: sandbox replay of the CI services, 2026-10-25, after rule R1 (Phase 25e)
